item.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
item.description:
What is Machine Learning?

Machine Learning (ML) is the core sub-field of AI. Its central idea is: let computers automatically learn patterns from data, without humans explicitly programming every rule.

Unlike traditional programming where “rules + data → answers”, machine learning works the other way: “data + answers → rules.”

Three Learning Paradigms

Supervised Learning

Training data has labels; the model learns a mapping from inputs to outputs.

Typical tasks: Classification (spam detection), Regression (price prediction)
